answer.reason: Only 2KI 20:20 is marked, but it and the context verse 2CH 32:30 state that Hezekiah made the conduit and brought water into the city, and that Gihon's upper watercourse was stopped and brought down to the city of David.

clauses.english: was made by Hezekiah to bring water into the city
clauses.quote: he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city

clauses.english: carried the stopped upper watercourse of Gihon straight down to the west side of the city of David
clauses.quote: stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David

doubts: The quote for the second clause exceeds 15 words in my selection, so it may need trimming; the verse is the evidence.
Isaiah 22 mentions pools and a ditch but does not name Hezekiah, so it was not cited.
